correctness.rationale: Exact proof: if d_i=u_i XOR u_(i+1) is ultimately h-periodic, u is ultimately 2h-periodic; contradiction. Complement-reversal-fixed length-n factors map at most two-to-one into ordinary palindromic length-(n-1) factors of d, while C_d(n-1)<=C_u(n). Shallit Theorem 4 applies to d, yielding logarithmic E-palindrome sparsity; applying it also to u controls R-palindromes. Burnside gives the group-orbit ratio exactly. All quantifiers and the n>=2 transfer boundary were checked; finite tests verify the local mechanism, not the limiting theorem.
